section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the cross-cultural adaptation of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) for a Brazilian target population, noting specific item wording changes (e.g., Items 5, 9, 10) and replacement/clarification of response options informed by adolescents' feedback. It also notes inclusion of a non-verbal (square-painting) response format and states that the final BAS version is presented in Figure 1; no sample sizes, demographic percentages, BMI data, or correlations are reported here.
section_summary.evidence_source: Only three items (5, 9 and 10) have not changed from the  version obtained from the cross-cultural adaptation by  Swami et al. (2011). Regarding the answer options, the terms rarely and often were replaced by almost never and many times, especially considering the suggestions of the adolescents interviewed... The final version of the BAS obtained from these changes is presented in Figure 1.
